text:
sana: FYI we've got a surge of embeddings 503s in eu-west1 starting ~08:12 UTC. Root appears to be a kvcache eviction race. I built a hotfix image: `gcr.io/redwood/serving:embed-kvguard-20260321`. Requesting expedited approval + pin for a fast canary (15m window).

deploybot: New deploy request received (sana). Canary plan: 1% for 3m -> 10% for 7m -> 100%. Rollback criteria: `embed_503_rate > 0.5%` sustained for 2m OR `embed_request_p99 +150ms`. Required approvers: oncall, infra. CI status: unit/integration checks passed; e2e flaky but non-blocking.

amir: Oncall here. I'll watch metrics and own post-deploy rollback decision. +1 if infra OK.

priya: Quick read: change is in serving path only, adds a lock around cache-insert. No model or data changes. I'm +1 infra but will watch CPU and lock contention.

jun: Can we add a temporary header flag so we can route e.g. `x-hotfix-pin: v2026-03-21-e1`? We typically use that for quick reverts.

sana: yes, pin header implemented. Pin name: `v2026-03-21-e1`. Starting canary when deploybot ready.

deploybot: Canary deploy starting -> 1% (eu-west1). Logs: https://deploy/logs/1823456789. Tagging releasebot.

releasebot: Release note draft: "Hotfix: guard race causing intermittent embeddings 503 in eu-west1. Rolling out staged canary and pinning to v2026-03-21-e1. Monitoring enabled."

amir: 1min in: embed_503_rate down by 0.6% vs baseline. p99 unchanged. Good so far.

priya: seeing slight uptick in CPU for a small subset of pods (lock wait). Not yet alarming.

amir: after 3m, rolling to 10% per plan.

deploybot: Ramp to 10% -> in progress -> complete.

opsbot: Reminder: watchlist endpoints: `eu-west1/embeds/*`, `kvcache/misses`, `cpu/lockwait`. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/embed-kvguard.

jun: 2m into 10% and p99 rose +200ms in one AZ (eu-west1-b). embed_503_rate still lower overall. Can we isolate to that AZ?
sana: initiating targeted rollback for eu-west1-b only and keep rest at 10%. deploybot, can you pin traffic away from eu-west1-b?

deploybot: Partial rollback requested -> shifting traffic away from eu-west1-b. Status: shift applied (eu-west1-b -> old image).

amir: After shift, p99 for remaining nodes back to baseline. eu-west1-b still showing p99 +200ms on older image too, possible infra flake.

priya: interesting — lock wait shouldn't affect older image. I'm going to run a quick jemalloc/profile check on the problematic hosts.

jun: Given the mixed signals, recommend we hold full rollout and keep the pin in place for the 10% pool while we investigate. Anyone object?
amir: No objection. Holding.

sana: Agreed. Pin remains `v2026-03-21-e1` for the canary pool. Setting follow-up ticket ENG-INC-4921 and assigning to priya + infra.

deploybot: Canary paused at 10%. Notifications sent to #eng-sre and #incidents-eu.

releasebot: Updated release note with status: "Partial canary (10%) rolled, partial AZ rollback to isolate issue; full rollout paused pending infra investigation."

priya: quick update after profiling: one host had kernel-level TCP retransmit spike due to noisy neighbor; unrelated to lock change. I've flagged host and requested reprovision.

amir: Once the host is reprovisioned, recommend we re-run canary ramp from 10% -> 25% -> 100% with same rollback criteria. Who will sign off?

sana: I'll re-request expedited approval once infra confirms reprovision. Thanks everyone. Closing for now, will reopen thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
